clause: Shape Builder tool over shared boolean core [STU-VEC-050,STU-VEC-007 Shape Builder]

scope.summary: Implement the Shape Builder tool as an interactive front-end over the same VectorEngine boolean core used by the explicit geometry operations: drag across overlapping regions to merge (resolves to union), click to extract/delete regions (resolves to subtract/divide), composing custom geometry without manual boolean stacking so gestural and command-driven geometry share one deterministic implementation + result contract.
acceptance_criteria: Shape Builder over shared boolean core; gestures match explicit ops; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: Shape Builder reachable via author_id
test: merge gesture == union + extract gesture == subtract/divide (same result contract as explicit ops)

risk_if_missed: No gestural geometry composition; Shape Builder workflow missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
